name: Miso-Hoisin Rice Noodles with Veggie Ground, Bok Choy & Bell Pepper
instructions: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once the water is boiling, remove from heat and add the rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes, or according to package directions, then drain in a colander and rinse under cold water; set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and cut bok choy crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the bok choy.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and slice celery crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add vegetables, veggie ground, miso paste, and spices. Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until cooked through and the vegetables are tender, 4-5 minutes.
Add drained noodles and hoisin sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until noodles and sauce are warmed through, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide saucy noodles, veggie ground, and vegetables between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
